page_title: FIO 1-2 UDI | Fiorentina v Udinese 23/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Matteo Marcenaro has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Now Fiorentina have a corner.
90+5' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) picks up a yellow card.
90+4' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for David de Gea to dive and make a save.

90+1' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

89' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marcenaro with no other option than to blow for a foul. Fiorentina win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

88' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Razvan Sava, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Thauvin departs the field of play to be replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
87' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue is replaced by Rui Modesto (Udinese).
86' Substitution. Robin Gosens makes way for Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
86' The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
85' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.

83' The ball falls kindly for Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
81' A yellow card for a tackle by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina). Matteo Marcenaro doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
80' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Fiorentina.
78' Total attempts – 10:9.

75' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
73' Razvan Sava (Udinese) receives a yellow card for infringement.
70' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Andrea Colpani will be replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
70' The substitution has been made. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) has replaced Riccardo Sottil.
69' That was close by Moise Kean (Fiorentina)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
68' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Jurgen Ekkelenkamp and he is replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
65' The ball is behind the sideline. Jordan Zemura (Udinese) takes a throw-in.
62' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) replacing Lucas Beltran.
62' The substitution is prepared. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yacine Adli.
60' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.

57' 1 - 2 Goal! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. David de Gea had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
55' Corner kick. Fiorentina will have an opportunity.
55' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
52' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
51' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
51' The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.

49' 1 - 1 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the left post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:1.
49' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marcenaro after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Kosta Runjaic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Isaak Toure (Udinese). He is replaced by James Abankwah.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' The free kick is taken by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina), but ball is cleared.
45+3' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
45+2' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

45+1' A pass travels right across the box to Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Razvan Sava denies him with a decent save.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' A player from Udinese commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Fiorentina are awarded the free kick.
42' It's a throw-in for Udinese.
40' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
40' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jordan Zemura (Udinese) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Some patient build-up play from Udinese as they look to unlock the defence.
36' Fiorentina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
33' The linesman signals that Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

32' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
30' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
29' 53:47 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
25' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Udinese! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Matteo Marcenaro and both teams have no complaints.

24' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Udinese.
23' Surely that's handball by one of the Fiorentina players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
22' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
21' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' A corner kick by Fiorentina is thwarted by the well prepared Razvan Sava (Udinese).

17' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but David de Gea comes off the line to clear the ball away.
12' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

10' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Matteo Marcenaro who sees an offensive foul. Free kick. Udinese will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Razvan Sava.
8' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
8' Referee Matteo Marcenaro awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
6' Referee Matteo Marcenaro makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fiorentina. Let’s see what happens!
5' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) is booked for saying more than Matteo Marcenaro was willing to tolerate.
5' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
3' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marcenaro.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
